releases.name: V0.3.0 Emergency Thrusters
releases.body:
# Resource Management v0.3.0

### Ship Emergency Thrusters
- They work about the same as your suit: When you run out of fuel, they will activate and drain oxygen at a *very* quick rate whenever you're thrusting, so watch out.

### Mod settings
- Now you can access the mod configuration from the Mods tabs in the game settings. You'll be able to customize certain parameters such as oxygen regeneration rate, or enable / disable certain functions.

### And *a* bug fix
- (Hopefully) fixed a NRE spam in console after dying / meditating


- Removed code

releases.name: V0.2.0 New mechanics
releases.body:
# 0.2.0 patch notes
- When buckling up, oxygen in your suit will transfer to the ship's tank (If it has enough capacity to do so). This fixes a bug that kills the player if they try to buckle up with no oxygen in the ship.
- Refilling your jetpack now draws fuel from the ship's fuel tank.
- Refilling oxygen now draws oxygen from the ship's oxygen tank.
- Added a refueling speed multiplier when landing back in the land pad in Timber Hearth. This comes with a purple light in the fuel gauge.
- Made a few internal changes to how Oxygen in the ship is handled (Now it draw's 1 unit per second, same as the player).
releases.bodyZh:
# 0.2.0 版本更新日志
- 系统在安全带固定时，宇航服中的氧气会转移到飞船的储氧罐（前提是储氧罐有足够容量）。此修复了在飞船内无氧气时尝试安全带固定会导致玩家死亡的问题。
- 现在为喷射背包充能会从飞船的燃料罐中抽取燃料。
- 现在为氧气充能会从飞船的氧气罐中抽取氧气。
- 在木炉星着陆时添加了充能速度倍率，燃料量表中会显示紫色光芒。
- 对飞船内氧气处理方式进行了若干内部调整（现在每秒抽取1单位，与玩家相同）。
